questions.stem: A 50- year male presented with complaints of right leg pain for 2 months and an ulcer over the left foot for 1 month. He is a known smoker for the past 25 years and a known diabetic on oral hypoglycaemic drugs. On examination of limb ulcer of size, 2*2cm is seen over the dorsal aspect of the left foot. Skin is thinned, with diminished growth of hair. Peripheral pulses are feeble. Which of the following is the most common cause of limb ischemia?
